title: NFG Partners launches in Dubai: one adviser, the full picture
summary: Swiss investment group brings the independent Geneva model to families and family offices across the Middle East

contentHtml:
John Barrowman, Founding Partner and Senior Executive Officer of NFG Partners (DIFC) Limited. Image courtesy: NFG Partners

Swiss investment group brings the independent Geneva model to families and family offices across the Middle East

Press Release

DUBAI, UAE: NFG Partners, the independent Swiss investment group from Geneva, has launched NFG Partners (DIFC) Limited, giving families, family offices, entrepreneurs and institutions across the Middle East one independent adviser for their entire investment portfolio, across multiple banks and jurisdictions. The firm marked its launch with a reception in Dubai on 18 November.

As DIFC continues to expand, the number of individuals in the UAE with more than USD 100 million is forecast to grow by around 60% by 2030, according to Boston Consulting Group’s Global Wealth Report 2026. Those families rarely bank in one place. Most have several banks, several relationship managers and several reports, and no one who sees how it all fits together. NFG Partners was built to be that one adviser.

Because NFG Partners is independent and not tied to any single bank, its advice starts with the family’s objectives. It looks across every bank, custodian and asset class, builds one strategy and one asset allocation, and reports on all of it in one place. It uses its long-standing banking relationships to negotiate terms for its clients.

The Dubai office has been regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority since August 2026. It is backed by NFG Partners SA in Geneva, regulated in Switzerland by FINMA, which runs discretionary portfolios for clients who prefer to delegate.

What NFG Partners offers

  • Investment advice across the whole portfolio, with one consolidated report covering every bank and custodian
  • Outsourced CIO oversight for family offices and institutions
  • Discretionary management through NFG Partners SA in Geneva
  • Advice on and arrangement of access to private equity, private credit and co-investment opportunities
  • Banking, credit and custody, arranged and negotiated on the client’s behalfThe Dubai office is led by John Barrowman, Founding Partner and Senior Executive Officer of NFG Partners (DIFC) Limited, who has advised international families across London, Geneva and Dubai.

“Families in this region are in transition. They are moving between countries, between banks and between generations, and those are the moments when a family most needs one adviser who sees the whole picture,” said John Barrowman. “That is what we bring. From the DIFC we give families one view of their whole portfolio and independent, regulated advice, working alongside their own lawyers and tax advisers. We do it with our Swiss heritage and our colleagues in Geneva behind us. We don’t think in quarters. We think in generations.”

“Opening our own regulated office in the DIFC is a long-term commitment to our clients and partners across the Middle East, and in John Barrowman we have the right partner to lead it,” said Zam Manji, Founding Partner, NFG Partners SA.

NFG Partners works with a select group of clients, each with a single senior point of contact. The Dubai office is the start of a long-term commitment to the region.
